ns2:section.sectionText: This section meets mostly online, but may have occasional in-person meetings. You will be charged an Art + Design Facilities Fee which will grant you access to the Art + Design Facilities. This course is intended for first-year students in the School of Art+Design.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Undeclared or Studio Art or Art and Art History or New Media major(s).
